item.title: Thousands of jobs to be cut at Virgin Media O2
item.body: The broadband provider has not finalised how many roles will go, but the cuts are likely to affect a sizeable part of its workforce, the BBC understands.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💼 Thousands of jobs to be cut at Virgin Media O2

The broadband provider has not finalised how many roles will go, but the cuts are likely to affect a sizeable part of its workforce, the BBC understands.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 1 November, 17:50
